reason: The household electricity tariff for the single-rate group G11 of two suppliers (Enea and Energa-Obrót), each with the charges of its own network operator (Enea Operator and Energa-Operator), as net prices before 23% VAT: energy, excise, network, quality, renewable and cogeneration charges per kWh, and the fixed network charge, subscription and capacity charge as a daily standing charge, in an area for each supply (single or three phase) and yearly use step. A plan is valid only in its operator's network area. The two-zone groups (G12, G12w), the other suppliers (PGE, Tauron, Stoen) and prepayment meters are not held.
